subject: general
question: Indian men's national cricket team created a record by defeating Sri Lanka by 317 runs in the final third match in January 2023 in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thiruvananthapuram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• On January 15, 2023, India defeated Sri Lanka by 317 runs in the third and final ODI match held at the Greenfield International Stadium in Thiruvananthapuram.
 
• This victory set a new record for the largest margin of victory in terms of runs in One Day Internationals (ODIs).
 
• Virat Kohli scored an unbeaten 166 runs off 110 balls, contributing significantly to India's record-breaking total.
 
• India posted a score of 390/5 in 50 overs, while Sri Lanka was bowled out for just 73 runs in 22 overs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Greenfield International Stadium**

 
 
• Located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, it is a multi-purpose stadium primarily used for cricket and football matches.
 
• The stadium has a seating capacity of approximately 55,000 spectators.
 
• It is known for its state-of-the-art facilities and has hosted several international and domestic matches.
 
 
 
• **One Day International (ODI) Cricket**
 
 
• ODI cricket is a format of limited-overs cricket, played between two teams with each team facing a fixed number of overs, usually 50.
 
• The first ODI match was played between Australia and England on January 5, 1971, at the Melbourne Cricket Ground.
 
• ODI matches are known for their fast-paced and strategic gameplay, often resulting in high scores and exciting finishes.
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli**
 
 
• Virat Kohli is an Indian cricketer and former captain of the Indian national team in all formats of the game.
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the best batsmen in the world and holds numerous records in international cricket.
 
• Kohli has been awarded several prestigious accolades, including the ICC Cricketer of the Year and the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award.
 
 
 
• **Sri Lanka National Cricket Team**
 
 
• The Sri Lankan national cricket team represents Sri Lanka in international cricket and is governed by Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC).
 
• Sri Lanka won the ICC Cricket World Cup in 1996 and has also won the ICC T20 World Cup in 2014.
 
• The team is known for its talented players and competitive spirit in all formats of the game.
